title: [LOGGED OUT] Header shows the logo and all menu items in order

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Does the header show, from left to right: the logo with "PRODUCT STORE", then "Home", "Contact", "About us", "Cart", "Log in", "Sign up"?
steps.saw: Left-to-right x positions: PRODUCT STORE (logo) 16, Home 801, Contact 860, About us 932, Cart 1011, Log in 1057, Sign up 1115
